# When Better Agent Behavior Does Not Improve Accuracy
> Author: Moran Zavdi · License: Apache-2.0 · Org: Aeterna Data AI/ML Research

## Thesis
Shorter reasoning, earlier submission, and fewer timeouts can improve apparent agent process without raising working-tree repair accuracy (Think-1024: 48/150 = 48/150).
